COUNT LOCK — THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT RULE: the LAST image provided is the guest photo. Count the people in it. The output must contain EXACTLY that many people — not one more, not one fewer. One person in the photo means one person alone in the output. Three people means exactly those three. Five means exactly those five. You are FORBIDDEN from inventing, adding, duplicating, cloning, mirroring or imagining any person who is not in that photo. Do not add anyone to balance the composition, fill empty space, fill the frame width, or make the group look bigger. If the people do not fill the frame, leave the remaining space to the environment — empty space is correct and expected. The grand architectural space behind and beside them is completely empty of other people — no extra staff, no bystanders, no faces in the distance.

IDENTITY LOCK: use the faces, identities and appearance of the subject or subjects in the provided photo. Keep each one exactly as they appear — same pose, same position, same gesture, same left-to-right order. Each keeps their own exact facial features, face shape, skin tone and undertone, ethnicity, hairstyle, hairline, hair length and hair colour, facial hair, body size and build, and every personal accessory (prescription glasses, headscarf, watch, jewellery). Do not blend, swap, average or beautify any face. Do not lighten or whiten any skin tone. Do not slim, widen or reshape any body. Do not make anyone look younger or older. Do not change anyone's gender. Every face stays fully visible and unobstructed — nothing covers anyone's eyes, nose or mouth. Each looks toward the camera with a natural, confident, closed-mouth smile.

WARDROBE — INTENTIONALLY CHANGED: ignore the clothing worn in the provided photo and dress everyone in a modern crisp white designer food-science lab coat over a light collared shirt, with an ID badge clipped at the chest. Small neat high-definition embroidered Garudafood logo on the left chest, palm-sized. Anyone wearing a headscarf keeps it, in plain white to match, with long sleeves. Anyone wearing prescription glasses keeps them. No hairnet, no mask, no goggles.

BRAND MARK: the FIRST image provided is the Garudafood corporate logo — a blue eagle head facing right with a gold beak and a blue leaf sprig below it, beside the bold blue "Garudafood" wordmark. Reproduce it accurately, keeping the blue and gold colours and eagle shape intact. It appears as a neat high-definition embroidered crest on the left chest of every coat, and as a subtle illuminated architectural relief sign softly recessed on the far curved wall.

PRODUCTS & SENSORY TASTING SPREAD — COPY, DO NOT INVENT: on the gleaming white quartz kitchen island counter in the foreground, display an appetizing, professional food-science sensory tasting spread:
- Several small white ceramic tasting bowls and ramekins filled with delicious loose ready-to-eat Garudafood snacks: golden roasted peanuts (kacang Garuda), round crunchy pilus, crispy chocolate wafer rolls (Chocolatos), and golden cheese biscuits (Gery).
- 2 to 3 clear glass apothecary ingredient display jars (toples kaca) with wooden or stainless steel lids, filled with roasted peanuts, whole grains, and raw snack ingredients.
- A tasteful pair of real Garudafood snack retail packs standing neatly behind the bowls, matching the product sheet artwork and legible brand names (Garuda, Gery, Chocolatos).
The snacks look fresh, crisp, appetizing, and inviting, like a high-end food TV commercial sensory evaluation.

SCENE: standing behind an expansive, pristine curved white quartz tasting island counter in a magnificent, double-height culinary innovation center and food-science pavilion. Soaring curved floor-to-ceiling glass walls look out onto a manicured green corporate campus bathed in daylight. Gleaming continuous island counters of polished stainless steel and white quartz recede into vast architectural depth. On the counter in front of them: multiple small white tasting bowls filled with delicious loose snacks, clear glass ingredient jars (toples kaca), and a neat display of prototype packs. Recessed ambient lighting ribbons and floating minimalist ring pendants glow warmly above. Grand, spacious, world-class commercial food-lab set.

FRAMING & HERO COMPOSITION — LARGE BOLD SCALE: Photographed at natural standing eye-level with a subtle, confident heroic angle (horizon level, not tilted, not a selfie).
- CROP: Crisp waist-up / upper-body crop (from belt/navel level upwards to just above the head). Legs, knees, and thighs are NOT in the frame. The heads are placed cleanly in the upper third of the frame, avoiding excessive empty headroom.
- GROUP SCALE (FOR 2 OR 3 PEOPLE): When 2 or more people are in the photo, they stand side-by-side confidently and naturally as professional corporate colleagues. Stand independently with clean posture and respectful spacing — ABSOLUTELY NO hugging, NO embracing, NO arms wrapped around shoulders or waists, NO romantic couple poses, NO holding hands. The subjects boldly and prominently fill the width of the frame — it is completely expected and encouraged for outer shoulders and arms to extend right to the frame edges, with a natural 5% to 10% crop at the left and right borders so that the people appear significantly larger, bolder, and more prominent in the frame rather than shrunk or distant.
- SINGLE SUBJECT: Bold, commanding upper-body presence filling the frame with prestige.
- Every face is large, clear, tack-sharp, and individually recognizable with natural warm expressions.

LIGHTING: luminous high-key commercial lighting — abundant soft daylight flooding from towering glass windows, clean soft key light on every face, and crisp specular rim lights separating shoulders from the gleaming pavilion behind. Highlights glinting off the glass jars and tasting bowls. Fresh, airy, premium food-science TV commercial aesthetic.

CAMERA: ARRI Alexa 35, Zeiss Supreme Prime 50mm, f/2.2. Sweeping architectural perspective, tack sharp subjects with deep creamy bokeh across the vast kitchen pavilion. Visible natural skin texture, clean film roll-off.

GRADE: rich cinematic TV commercial colour grade with controlled contrast — lifted filmic blacks, radiant warm highlights, pristine neutral skin tones. Expensive FMCG brand campaign polish. High resolution.

DO NOT: hugging, embracing, romantic couple poses, cuddling, arms wrapped around each other, holding hands, leaning heads together; add, duplicate or invent any person; blend, swap, average or beautify any face; lighten or smooth any skin; slim or reshape any body; cover any face with a mask, goggles, hairnet, cap or hand; use a selfie angle, fisheye or tilted horizon; show feet, shoes, knees, thighs or a full-body view; camera positioned too far away; people appearing small or distant; render any invented text, slogan, price tag or signage wording — the only legible text allowed is the Garudafood wordmark and the real brand names printed on the product packs copied from the product sheet; add a watermark; flat even lighting, dull flat grading, stock photo look, oversaturate, add HDR halos, harsh shadows or dark faces. NEVER add a person who is not in the guest photo — no extra colleague, no background figure, no duplicate of anyone, no reflection of a person; the people count must match the guest photo exactly.
video_positive_prompt: The people in the video look directly at the camera with big joyful smiles, actively raising their hands and waving enthusiastically in a friendly greeting (dadah-dadah hand wave). Lively hand waving motion, cheerful smiling expressions, natural eye blinking and head movement. Static tripod camera, fixed camera framing, no zoom, no camera movement. Keep exact same people, faces, hair, uniforms, clothing, and Garudafood brand logos perfectly consistent. Continuous seamless action throughout the entire video from the first second to the very end, constant bright lighting, no fade out, no fade to black, no black frames at the end, perfectly visible until the final frame. Grand double-height culinary innovation pavilion with quartz island counter, multiple small snack tasting bowls, clear glass jars (toples kaca), stainless steel islands and soft daylight, 4k cinematic commercial finish.
